name: sandbox-enforcer
description: Advanced hook example that enforces workspace isolation - prevents agents from navigating or writing outside their assigned directory. Useful for running multiple parallel conversations safely on a local machine.

examples.title: Blocked navigation outside workspace
examples.prompt: Navigate to /tmp and create a file there
examples.expected_behavior: Hook blocks cd /tmp command with workspace isolation message

examples.title: Allowed operations within workspace
examples.prompt: Create a new file in the current directory

examples.title: Read-only escape hatch
examples.expected_behavior: Hook allows read operations outside workspace
